**At the unchanged fits' response rates the refits keep less than half of their recovery.** Their pattern part lies between their own as fitted and that at fixed scales, which has the same response rates; what they lose is in the shape part (the table). Of the {{diff:E102/h_compare_inhadd1000.csv:unit=S;row=fixed scales at inhadd1000 (part B):cal_z8_pattern -- E102/h_compare_inhadd1000.csv:unit=S;row=refit at inhadd1000:cal_z8_pattern ~ .4f}} taken back from the fixed scales, {{diff:E102/h_compare_inhadd1000.csv:unit=S;row=fixed scales at inhadd1000 (part B):cal_z8_pattern -- E102/h_readings_inhadd1000.csv:change=H1;unit=S;readout=cal:z8_pattern ~ .4f}} is kept. The reading fixed beforehand called the recovery kept at {{lit:0.0527 # experiment_priorities.md in the shared directory, the entry of this experiment, the addendum of 2026-11-16 on the refits at matched response counts, the reading of the refits held to the unchanged fits' counts: two thirds or more of the recovery from the fixed scales is kept at a pattern part of 0.0527 or lower; fixed before any of it ran (also thresholds, H1_KEEP, in results/E102_antennal_lobe_normalization/h_class_inhadd1000.json, a JSON file, which the filler does not read)}} or lower and lost at {{lit:0.0540 # experiment_priorities.md in the shared directory, the entry of this experiment, the addendum of 2026-11-16 on the refits at matched response counts, the reading of the refits held to the unchanged fits' counts: a third or less of the recovery is kept, and the recovery rests on the response counts, at a pattern part of 0.0540 or higher that is also above the refits as fitted against each of the four halves of the flies; fixed before any of it ran (also thresholds, H1_LOSE, in results/E102_antennal_lobe_normalization/h_class_inhadd1000.json, a JSON file, which the filler does not read)}} or higher, so that it is kept in part. Every wiring lies between its own two values, and the real wiring keeps the least.

**The response rates alone buy nothing.** Held to the refits' response rates, the unchanged fits read no lower than as fitted (the table). The reading fixed beforehand asked for {{lit:0.0480 # experiment_priorities.md in the shared directory, the entry of this experiment, the addendum of 2026-11-16 on the refits at matched response counts, the reading of the unchanged fits held to the refits' counts: a response-rate effect at a pattern part of 0.0480 or lower that is also lower than the unchanged fits' against each of the four halves of the flies; fixed before any of it ran (also thresholds, H2_LOW, in results/E102_antennal_lobe_normalization/h_class_inhadd1000.json, a JSON file, which the filler does not read)}} or lower before the recovery would be called the response rates', and took {{lit:0.0490 # experiment_priorities.md in the shared directory, the entry of this experiment, the addendum of 2026-11-16 on the refits at matched response counts, the reading of the unchanged fits held to the refits' counts: at a pattern part of 0.0490 or higher the counts alone buy nothing, and the refits held to the unchanged fits' counts measure a refit pushed off its optimum; fixed before any of it ran (also thresholds, H2_HIGH, in results/E102_antennal_lobe_normalization/h_class_inhadd1000.json, a JSON file, which the filler does not read)}} or higher to mean that they buy nothing. What the refits lose at the unchanged fits' response rates is thus the cost of holding a fit away from where it was fitted, and not a gain that the response rates had made.

**The price at matched response rates is a range.** It runs from {{diff:E102/h_compare_inhadd1000.csv:unit=S;row=refit at inhadd1000:cal_z8_pattern -- E102/h_readings_inhadd1000.csv:change=H2;unit=S;readout=cal:z8_pattern ~ +.4f}} at the refits' response rates to {{diff:E102/h_readings_inhadd1000.csv:change=H1;unit=S;readout=cal:z8_pattern -- E102/h_compare_inhadd1000.csv:unit=S;row=unchanged fits:cal_z8_pattern ~ +.4f}} at the unchanged fits', each the refits minus the unchanged fits at the same response rates; as fitted it is {{diff:E102/h_compare_inhadd1000.csv:unit=S;row=refit at inhadd1000:cal_z8_pattern -- E102/h_compare_inhadd1000.csv:unit=S;row=unchanged fits:cal_z8_pattern ~ +.4f}}. The upper end is past the {{lit:0.003 # experiment_priorities.md in the shared directory, the entry of this experiment, the classes of the refit: an equal keeps the pattern part within 0.003 against all recordings and against both halves of the first split of the flies (the rule of the PN boutons' share of APL's inhibition); fixed before any run}} that an equal allows and below the {{diff:E102/h_compare_inhadd1000.csv:unit=S;row=fixed scales at inhadd1000 (part B):cal_z8_pattern -- E102/h_compare_inhadd1000.csv:unit=S;row=unchanged fits:cal_z8_pattern ~ +.4f}} of the fixed scales. The class compares the fits as fitted, as fixed beforehand, and stands; no class is drawn from the fits that were held.

**On raw counts the refits' gains hold at matched response rates.** Held to the unchanged fits' response rates, the refits stay close to the mean APL effect and to the loss on raw counts that they had as fitted. The refits' response rates do not give either to the unchanged fits (the table).

**Realism.** Every run is inside the four realism bands: the six steps on the eight wirings, the four refits, the settings read beside and the fits held at matched response rates. The refits raise the somatic threshold to {{E102/d_params_inhadd1000.csv:wiring=real;param=fixed_thr:refit_over_unchanged ~ .2f}} to {{E102/d_params_inhadd1000.csv:wiring=P2;param=fixed_thr:refit_over_unchanged ~ .2f}} times the unchanged fits'. The gain on raw counts came with a cost at weak input: beside ma at 10^-7, the panel's weakest odors, B-myr and ms, lose KCs as well.

**How far the antennal lobe is changed.** At the picked step the constant in the divisor is {{E102/b_steps.csv:step=inhadd1000:value ~ .0f}} for a default of {{E102/b_steps.csv:step=identity:value ~ .1f}}, in the units of the model's lateral inhibition. That weakens a gain control that the antennal lobe is known to have. Only the last step, which removes it, had been called hard to defend beforehand.

**Limits.** What the readings rest on:

- The refits are four, so that the counts of wirings inside the flies' interval are descriptions; the rule of the strength comparison asks for six of eight.
- The fall that picks the step rests on one session's estimate of paa's ORN input at 10^-5, and is read in the recordings of the strength comparison. Under the other two sessions' estimates the unchanged family is inside the flies' intervals through the steeper readings of the indicator, at the claws and in APL, and flatter read in proportion ([the flies' KCs beside their APL along concentration](#kc-calyx-vs-apl)). The weak-odor ratios and the held-out flies' intervals are from recordings whose quality the experimenter who made them has not checked.
- paa enters the model with ORN input recorded at 10^-4, one log unit below the concentration of the KC recordings, and euc and -aPine with ORN input recorded at other concentrations than the KC recordings'. The main target's pairs with those three odors and the ratio of paa over ms rest on [ORN input at another concentration](#fn-concentrations).
- At low concentration the flies' response rate with APL output blocked (TNT) rests on {{E49/data_fractions.csv:panel=diag_mix;group=apl_output_blocked;odor=ma @ -7:n_recordings ~ .0f}} recordings.
- The rule that excludes a step with a silent odor was added after the scores had been seen. Without it the last step would have been a second strength at which to fit, for the reading in proportion.
- Each refit is one local search from its wiring's point at fixed scales, under a loss that reads both definitions of the model's side and the mean part, not the pattern part alone.
- The model has the 0.5 s pulse and no trial noise, except in the rows with the longer pulse.

**What follows.** Nothing is gained on the main target, and no base, bound or reference family is changed. Seven things are carried from here:

- **The family's flat APL stands as a stated departure from the flies, with its price.** An antennal lobe that lets the family's APL fall as the flies' does, through the steeper readings of the indicator, costs little on the pattern part, in its shape part. It buys the mean APL effect on raw counts and costs KCs at weak input. Whether the base model's antennal lobe changes is a choice still to be made. The fit of that stage that had been set aside ([the model's stages against the flies' stages](#model-stages)) is closed with a number.
- **Whether the flies ask for the repair** has since been read ([the flies' KCs beside their APL along concentration](#kc-calyx-vs-apl)). The repair acts where the flies' fall is: the calyx signal of their KCs halves over the log unit of paa, as their APL and the ORN input's total do. Through the steeper readings of the indicator the unchanged family needs it only under the estimate of paa's input at 10^-5 that picked the step. At the weak odors the KCs' somata do not ask for it. Which estimate the base model's input takes comes before the setting of its antennal lobe.
- **The price is a range once the response rates are matched.** Held to the unchanged fits' response rates, the four refits keep less than half of their recovery, and the refits' response rates give the unchanged fits nothing. The price is read as {{diff:E102/h_compare_inhadd1000.csv:unit=S;row=refit at inhadd1000:cal_z8_pattern -- E102/h_readings_inhadd1000.csv:change=H2;unit=S;readout=cal:z8_pattern ~ +.4f}} to {{diff:E102/h_readings_inhadd1000.csv:change=H1;unit=S;readout=cal:z8_pattern -- E102/h_compare_inhadd1000.csv:unit=S;row=unchanged fits:cal_z8_pattern ~ +.4f}}, for {{diff:E102/h_compare_inhadd1000.csv:unit=S;row=refit at inhadd1000:cal_z8_pattern -- E102/h_compare_inhadd1000.csv:unit=S;row=unchanged fits:cal_z8_pattern ~ +.4f}} as fitted, and the class stands. A refit with the response rates held would put one number in the place of the range, and has not been run.
- **What recruits the flies' KCs at weak input** is the lead from the low concentrations: the thresholds, the noise, or a broad input that is real ([the per-claw threshold at low concentration](#low-concentration)). The lead has since been read like for like ([the KCs' response rates at the weak odors read like for like](#weak-odor-rates)): the family's shortfall turns on the session's estimate of the input, on the set of flies and on how a response is counted. On that reading the weaker normalization moves the KCs at ma further from the flies in half of the combinations of set, condition and estimate, and nearer in the other half.
- **The reading in proportion** is not reached by the normalization alone. Two things had been kept for that outcome and are now open to planning: the ceiling of the PNs' saturation, and a low-concentration input without its broad component. The second waits on whether that component of the ORN recordings is a response or a floor of the measurement.
- **The bouton path at the picked step** is the one setting read beside that lowers the refit's pattern part. Whether the family fitted again with it there would be an equal has not been read.
- **The rule's clause on raw counts** is to be decided, as said above. No result here depends on it.

### The flies' KCs beside their APL along concentration: whether the steep fall of the flies' APL with concentration is already in the calyx signal of their KCs, and how strong APL has to be at the weak odors for the best family's KCs to lose the share that the flies' KCs lose {#kc-calyx-vs-apl}

%%% hover
implied strength: At a weak odor, the strength of APL at which the best family's KCs lose to APL the share that the flies' KCs lose. APL's two scales are multiplied by a common factor, with every threshold as fitted, until the family's response rate with APL off over that with APL on equals the flies' ratio, APL output blocked (TNT) over control flies. The strength is APL's evoked activity there as a multiple of its evoked activity for paa at the fit. Defined in the subsection on the flies' KCs beside their APL along concentration.
%%%

**The goal was to learn whether the flies ask for the repair that the antennal lobe's normalization made.** Over a log unit of paa the flies' APL loses about half of its response and the best family's about a tenth ([the strength of APL's response in the flies against the model's APL](#apl-strength)). An antennal lobe under which the family's APL falls as far costs a little on the pattern part and takes KCs from the weakest odors ([the antennal lobe's normalization at the strength the flies' APL asks for](#al-normalization)).

**Two readings of the flies say whether that repair is wanted.** The first is whether the fall is already in the KCs' own signal in the calyx, where their claws receive their input. The second is whether APL takes a smaller share of the flies' KCs at weak odors than of the family's. No model is changed, and nothing is scored on [the APL-effect loss](#apl-effect).

**The fall is in the KCs' calyx signal.** Over a log unit of paa the calyx signal of the flies' KCs falls to about half, as far as the APL of the strength comparison. Whether the APL of flies of 2022 falls faster than the KCs is not decided. By the rule fixed beforehand the family's claws are inside the KCs' interval under two of the three estimates of paa's input at 10^-5; read in proportion they are flatter under all three.

**The weak odors do not ask for a weaker APL.** At three weak odors the family's own APL has the strength at which its KCs lose the share that the flies' KCs lose, by a rule under which one estimate of the input suffices. Whether the flies' APL calcium, read in proportion, is too weak for that share is not decided.

**The recordings.** In {{lit:55 # results/E104_kc_calyx_vs_apl/p0_identity.json: counts, groups, K6F, got, n_recordings}} recordings of {{E104/a2_falls.csv:reading=carrying;fall=G1:kc_n_flies ~ .0f}} flies, made from September to December 2022 and called the KC flies here, the KCs alone carry the indicator. Their signal was imaged in one plane through the calyx, with pa, paa and ms as concentration series, and their responses had not been opened for this work. With no indicator in APL they are free of the leak between two colours that left the dual-colour recordings undecided ([the flies' APL against their KC claws in the dual-colour recordings](#apl-vs-claws)).

**The APL flies beside them.** The KC flies are set against the same experimenter's APL flies of 2022 on the same stimuli: {{E104/a2_falls.csv:reading=set_S_alone;fall=G1:apl_n_flies ~ .0f}} flies in which APL alone is labelled, and the APL channel of the {{E101/a1_groups.csv:group=L:flies ~ .0f}} dual-colour flies, which the leak does not touch. The experimenter has not checked the quality of any of these recordings.

**The rules were fixed before the recordings were opened.** The definitions, the lists of recordings and the thresholds were committed before any response of the KC flies was read. A response is the peak change in fluorescence inside the outline of the calyx, each presentation taken against the solvent's at the same place in its block. A fall is the response at the lower of two concentrations over that at the higher, as the geometric mean over flies. Three falls carry the verdict: paa at 10^-5 over 10^-4, pa at 10^-5 over 10^-4 and ms at 10^-4 over 10^-3.

**How APL's fall is set against the KCs'.** For each fall APL's value is divided by the KCs'. Two sets of flies differ on a fall if fewer than one in ten of the ways of dividing all their flies into sets of the same sizes give a difference as large. APL is steeper if the sets differ and the ratio is below {{lit:0.8 # experiments/E104_part_a_lock.json (definitions fixed before any response of the KC-only recordings was read): classes, apl_steeper}}, and the two follow one function if they do not differ and the ratio's interval lies within {{lit:0.67 # experiments/E104_part_a_lock.json (definitions fixed before any response of the KC-only recordings was read): classes, one_function, lower end}} to {{lit:1.5 # experiments/E104_part_a_lock.json (definitions fixed before any response of the KC-only recordings was read): classes, one_function, upper end}}. The verdict needs two of the three falls.

**When a class is held.** A class is held only if the main reading and each of eleven further readings give it. Among them are other ways of taking the solvent, one depth alone, the marked recordings left out and each KC fly left out in turn.

The falls of the flies' APL and of the calyx signal of their KCs under the main reading: the geometric mean over flies, with the interval over resampled flies and the number of flies in parentheses. The first three rows carry the verdict and the next three are read beside it. The last row is the APL of the strength comparison's recordings, made in 2021

![Left: each fall for the APL flies of 2022 (blue; sets S and L in the legend are the flies with APL alone labelled and the APL channel of the dual-colour flies) and for the calyx signal of the KC flies (orange; set K), with its interval over resampled flies. **The KCs' calyx signal falls as far as the APL of the strength comparison.** Over the log unit of paa the KCs' calyx signal falls to {{E104/a2_falls.csv:reading=carrying;fall=G1:kc ~ .2f}}, the APL of the strength comparison's recordings to {{E98/a3_ratios.csv:ratio_id=V2;reading=order_matched;subset=all:ratio ~ .2f}} (the table) and the ORN input's total, by the estimate from the flies of paa at 10^-4, to {{lit:0.54 # data/model_outputs/E98_apl_response_strength/B/B1/b1_stimuli.csv (the model-output archive, which the filler does not read): input_total of paa [validation2/diag] @ -5 over that of paa, 608.57 / 1133.26 = 0.537}}. A fall to about half is thus already in the KCs' dendrites in the calyx, which carry the claws' input.

**That points to the claws' input, and does not decide it.** In the family APL follows the summed input to its claws ([above](#apl-vs-claws)), so that claws falling that far would take its APL with them. The flies' claws scale with the input over this step, where the family's do not.

**Whether the APL of 2022 falls faster than the KCs is not decided.** On all six falls APL's value lies below the KCs', with ratios of {{E104/a2_falls.csv:reading=carrying;fall=paa_-4_over_-3:q ~ .2f}} to {{E104/a2_falls.csv:reading=carrying;fall=G2:q ~ .2f}}, and only for ms at 10^-4 over 10^-3 do the two sets differ. That ratio sits on the cut, {{E104/a2_falls.csv:reading=carrying;fall=G3:q ~ .3f}} against {{lit:0.8 # experiments/E104_part_a_lock.json (definitions fixed before any response of the KC-only recordings was read): classes, apl_steeper}}, and is called APL steeper under {{lit:7 # results/E104_kc_calyx_vs_apl/a2_x1.csv: the number of readings whose G3 is APL steeper}} of the {{lit:12 # results/E104_kc_calyx_vs_apl/a2_x1.csv: the number of readings (rows)}} readings. For paa the APL flies of 2022 fall further than the KCs, but vary about three times as much from fly to fly ({{E104/d_x1_counts.csv:reading=carrying;fall=G1;scenario=kc;cls=APL steeper:sd_apl_log2 ~ .2f}} against {{E104/d_x1_counts.csv:reading=carrying;fall=G1;scenario=kc;cls=APL steeper:sd_kc_log2 ~ .2f}} in the base-two logarithm). No fall has a held class, so that the verdict is not decided.

The fall from paa at 10^-4 to paa at 10^-5 in the flies and in the best family, at the claws and in APL, with paa's input at 10^-5 from each of the three sessions of ORN recordings. Flies: the geometric mean with the interval over resampled flies. Family: the range over the eight wirings. The claw drive is the summed input to the claws; every reading of the claws adds the family of indicator nonlinearities and a quarter or a half of a KC's spikes counted in its claws' signal. A wiring is inside if any reading lies in the flies' interval

**By the rule the family's claws are inside under two of the three estimates.** With paa's input from the mixture session or from the megamat session, all eight wirings have a reading of the claws inside the interval of the KCs' calyx signal (the table). With the validation2 session's estimate the claws fall too little on {{lit:6 # results/E104_kc_calyx_vs_apl/a3_x2_wirings.csv: reading carrying, estimate validation2: the number of the eight wirings whose cls is flatter}} of the eight. The family's APL does the same against the flies' APL. By the rule fixed beforehand one estimate suffices, so that the claws are inside, under every reading of the flies' side.

**Read in proportion the family is flatter under all three.** Over the log unit of paa the family's claw drive keeps at least {{E104/a3_x2_wirings.csv:wiring=real;reading=carrying;estimate=kiwi-control:ratio_linear_max ~ .2f}} of its size and its APL at least {{E98/comparison_table.csv:comparison=V2 beside, paa at 10^-5 from kiwi-control/diag:model_linear_min ~ .2f}}, where the flies' KCs keep {{E104/a2_falls.csv:reading=carrying;fall=G1:kc ~ .2f}} and their APL {{E98/a3_ratios.csv:ratio_id=V2;reading=order_matched;subset=all:ratio ~ .2f}}. Inside is reached only through the steeper readings of the indicator, or for the claws with a share of a KC's spikes counted in their signal. The estimate thus decides how far the family is from the flies, and whether those readings close the distance.

**The estimate that carried the earlier verdicts is the one from the same flies.** The strength comparison and the antennal lobe's normalization took the validation2 session's estimate, from the flies in which paa's input at 10^-4 was recorded. The other two come from other sessions' flies and are weaker (the table). Under them the family's KCs nearly stop responding to paa at 10^-5, where {{E101/a3_family.csv:wiring=M3;cond=on;stimulus=paa:kc_rate ~ .3f}} to {{E101/a3_family.csv:wiring=P4;cond=on;stimulus=paa:kc_rate ~ .3f}} of them respond at 10^-4. Which estimate is right is a question about the ORN input, and no recordings of the KCs' somata exist at 10^-5 to say.

**The weakest concentrations read a floor.** At 10^-7 every KC fly that was imaged there responds above the solvent, to each of the three odors. That is not held: one fly was imaged down to 10^-6 only for paa and ms, so that leaving out any other fly leaves three flies where the rule asks for four. Nor does the response grow there: at 10^-8 the KCs' signal is as large as at 10^-7 ({{E104/a1_strengths.csv:set=K6F;odor=paa;conc=-8.0:response ~ .2f}} and {{E104/a1_strengths.csv:set=K6F;odor=paa;conc=-7.0:response ~ .2f}} for paa). The lowest concentrations thus read a floor of the measurement as much as a response.

**At the weak odors the question is put to the KCs' somata.** Three stimuli of the low-concentration KC recordings ([the per-claw threshold at low concentration](#low-concentration)) exist with and without APL's output: 2h and ma at 10^-7 and farn at 10^-3. Blocking APL's output raises the flies' response rate to them {{E104/b_flies.csv:odor=ma;reading=carrying:ratio ~ .1f}} to {{E104/b_flies.csv:odor=farn;reading=carrying:ratio ~ .1f}} times. The family was run on them on the eight wirings at their fits, with APL's two scales multiplied by a common factor of {{E104/variants.csv:real_m0.15:m ~ .2f}} to {{E104/variants.csv:real_m2:m ~ .0f}} and every threshold as fitted. Each odor's input was taken in turn from the diagnostic odors of each of the three sessions of ORN recordings.

**The implied strength.** APL's strength is its evoked activity as a multiple of its evoked activity for paa at the fit. The implied strength is the strength at which the family's KCs lose the flies' share: the family's response rate with APL off over that with APL on then equals the flies' ratio, APL output blocked (TNT) over control flies.

**What is set against it.** Two strengths are: the family's own at its fit, and the flies' APL read in proportion, as its response to the weak odor over that to paa at 10^-3 in {{E104/b_flies_apl.csv:odor=2h:n_flies ~ .0f}} flies recorded for the flies' APL at the weak odors ([below](#apl-weak-odors)). A strength is too weak if it lies below the whole interval of a wiring's implied strength, and too strong if above it. A class needs six of the eight wirings, one estimate of the input suffices for inside, and the verdict needs two of the three odors.

The three weak odors in the flies and in the best family. KC data: the response rates and their ratio, with its interval over resampled control flies, each recording with APL output blocked (TNT) left out in turn. The flies' APL: the mean over flies with its interval. Family: the range over the eight wirings, and over the three estimates of the input where no session is named. A strength is classed against each wiring's own interval of the implied strength, wider than the range of central values shown. The model's input for 2h is at 10^-6 and for farn at 10^-2

![The three weak odors, with the flies' concentration and that of the model's input in the titles. Each line is one wiring under one session's estimate of the input (blue the mixture session, kiwi-control in the legend; orange megamat; green validation2): the family's response rate with APL off over that with APL on against APL's strength, with a dot at the fit. Grey band: the KC data's ratio with its interval; the implied strength is where a line meets it. Violet band: the flies' APL over its response to paa at 10^-3 (set W in the legend).](results/E104_kc_calyx_vs_apl/E104_ladder.png)

**The family's own APL takes the share that the flies' KCs imply.** By the rule the family's own strength is inside the implied strength at all three odors under the main reading and each of five further readings, so that the class is held. By that rule the flies' KCs at the weak odors do not ask for an APL weaker than the family's.

**That class rests on the rule's lenient clause.** One estimate of the input suffices for inside. At 2h the family is inside as a class only with the mixture session's input, and at ma only with the validation2 session's. With the mixture session's input, with which ma had been run before, its APL is too strong there on all eight wirings.

**Whether the flies' APL, read in proportion, is too weak is not decided.** The flies' APL responds to the weak odors at {{E104/b_flies_apl.csv:odor=ma:apl ~ .2f}} to {{E104/b_flies_apl.csv:odor=farn:apl ~ .2f}} of its response to paa at 10^-3, below the family's own strength at every odor. Under the main reading it is inside the implied strength at 2h and at ma only with the mixture session's input, the lowest of the three, and too weak at farn under every estimate. A reading that counts one spike or more as a response leaves 2h not decided, so that the class is not held.

**If the flies' present ratios are the true ones, that class becomes too weak.** Read in proportion, APL's calcium would then understate what APL does to the KCs at weak input. An indicator alone does not reconcile the three odors. For the flies' APL to meet the implied strength its exponent would have to be about {{lit:2.2 # results/E104_kc_calyx_vs_apl/b3_exponents.csv: the median of n_star over the wirings and the three estimates, odor ma}} at ma, inside the family of indicator nonlinearities, but about {{lit:4.5 # results/E104_kc_calyx_vs_apl/b3_exponents.csv: the median of n_star over the wirings and the three estimates, odor 2h}} at 2h and {{lit:7.7 # results/E104_kc_calyx_vs_apl/b3_exponents.csv: the median of n_star over the wirings and the three estimates, odor farn}} at farn, the medians over the wirings and the estimates that give one.

**The share is right, and the levels are low.** At the weak odors fewer of the family's KCs respond than of the flies', with APL on and with APL off. The implied strength is thus a ratio of two response rates that are both too low. With an APL as weak as the flies' calcium read in proportion, the family's response rate with APL on would be {{E104/b1_rates.csv:odor=2h;estimate=kiwi-control;wiring=real;n=1.0:rate_on ~ .3f}} to {{E104/b1_rates.csv:odor=2h;estimate=validation2;wiring=P3;n=1.0:rate_on ~ .3f}} at 2h, {{E104/b1_rates.csv:odor=ma;estimate=kiwi-control;wiring=P2;n=1.0:rate_on ~ .3f}} to {{E104/b1_rates.csv:odor=ma;estimate=validation2;wiring=P3;n=1.0:rate_on ~ .3f}} at ma and {{E104/b1_rates.csv:odor=farn;estimate=kiwi-control;wiring=M2;n=1.0:rate_on ~ .3f}} to {{E104/b1_rates.csv:odor=farn;estimate=validation2;wiring=P2;n=1.0:rate_on ~ .3f}} at farn, reaching the control flies' at the upper ends. A weaker APL would repair the level with APL on and lose the share.

**Both parts of that reading have since been read like for like.** With the flies' three sets of recordings kept apart and the solvent's responders removed, whether the levels are low turns on the session's estimate of the input, on the set of flies and on how a response is counted. With the flies' ratio taken within the one set that holds the flies with APL output blocked (TNT), the family's own APL is too strong at ma under every estimate, and the verdict over the three odors stays inside ([the KCs' response rates at the weak odors read like for like](#weak-odor-rates)).

**How many flies would decide.** Taking the present means and the spreads between flies as the truth, and a normal approximation of the rule on the splits:

- **The fall of paa.** About {{E104/d_x1_counts.csv:reading=carrying;fall=G1;scenario=both;cls=APL steeper:new_flies_p50 ~ .0f}} new flies in each set would call APL steeper there with a chance of one half. A chance of four in five takes {{E104/d_x1_counts.csv:reading=carrying;fall=G1;scenario=both;cls=APL steeper:new_flies_p80 ~ .0f}}, and {{E104/d_x1_counts.csv:reading=carrying;fall=G3;scenario=both;cls=APL steeper:new_flies_p80 ~ .0f}} for the fall of ms, which the verdict needs as well. More KC flies alone never do, since it is the spread among the APL flies that limits the comparison.
- **A held class** is reached with no number of flies: with the present means, some readings of paa's fall and of ms's lie on the other side of the cut.
- **The flies' APL at the weak odors.** More recordings with APL output blocked (TNT) do not bound the class alone, since the control flies set the interval of the flies' ratio. About {{E104/d_y_counts.csv:reading=carrying;verdict=Y1;odor=2h;scenario=both_own;cls=too weak:new_p50 ~ .0f}} new flies of each genotype would call it too weak with a chance of one half, or {{E104/d_y_counts.csv:reading=carrying;verdict=Y1;odor=2h;scenario=both_ctrl_spread;cls=too weak:new_p50 ~ .0f}} if flies with APL output blocked (TNT) vary as control flies do. A class held under every reading takes {{lit:95 # results/E104_kc_calyx_vs_apl/d_summary.json: y, too_weak_held, Y1, both_own, p50}}, or {{lit:202 # results/E104_kc_calyx_vs_apl/d_summary.json: y, too_weak_held, Y1, both_ctrl_spread, p50}} with that wider spread.

**Realism.** No model was changed or fitted. The fits of the eight wirings are read as saved, and all eight are inside the four realism bands. The runs with APL scaled are a probe of APL's strength on the weak stimuli alone, at fixed thresholds, so that no band is read on them; the largest spike count in them is {{E104/b_model.csv:wiring=M2;m=0.15;stimulus=2h [megamat/diag] @ -6:max_spike_count ~ .0f}}, for {{E104/b_model.csv:wiring=M2;m=1.0;stimulus=2h [megamat/diag] @ -6:max_spike_count ~ .0f}} at the fits. What the experiment adds beside the bands is that at the weak odors the family gives APL the flies' share of the KCs from response rates below the flies' in both conditions.

**Limits.** What the readings rest on:

- The experimenter has not checked the quality of the recordings. For one further fly of 2022 it is not settled whether the KCs or APL carry the indicator; it was read apart, as either, and changes no verdict.
- Each cell type is read in one plane of the calyx, in flies of its own. On the same indicator the KCs' signal is a quarter to a half of APL's ({{E104/a1_strengths.csv:set=K6F;odor=paa;conc=-4.0:response ~ .2f}} against {{E104/a1_strengths.csv:set=S;odor=paa;conc=-4.0:response ~ .2f}} for paa at 10^-4), so that a nonlinear indicator can make two falls differ where the calcium does not.
- The KCs' calyx signal mixes the claws' input with the dendrites' own response, and neither is the model's claw stage one to one.
- paa enters the model with ORN input recorded at 10^-4, 2h at 10^-6 and farn at 10^-2, each one log unit from the concentration of the KC recordings ([ORN input at another concentration](#fn-concentrations)); ma's input is at the recorded concentration, and euc and -aPine are not involved. APL's strength is counted in units of its response to paa, so that paa's input bears on the flies' APL against the implied strength and not on the family's own strength.
- The flies' ratio at the weak odors rests on {{E104/b_flies.csv:odor=2h;reading=carrying:n_tnt_recordings ~ .0f}} recordings of {{E104/b_flies.csv:odor=2h;reading=carrying:n_tnt_flies ~ .0f}} flies with APL output blocked (TNT), a block that lasts the fly's life, set against the model's acute removal of APL.
- The numbers of flies that would decide come from the spreads among {{E104/a2_falls.csv:reading=carrying;fall=G1:kc_n_flies ~ .0f}} to {{E104/b_flies.csv:odor=2h;reading=carrying:n_ctrl_flies ~ .0f}} flies a set.

**What follows.** Nothing is gained or lost on the main target, and no base, bound or reference family is changed. Five things are carried from here:

- **The flies' steep APL points to their claws' input.** Over the log unit of paa the KCs' calyx signal halves as the APL of the strength comparison does. A family whose claws fell as far would have an APL that falls as far, with no change in what drives APL. Whether the APL of 2022 falls further than the KCs stays open.
- **How flat the family is along concentration turns on the estimate of paa's input at 10^-5.** Read in proportion it is flatter than the flies under all three estimates. Through the steeper readings of the indicator it is flatter only under the validation2 session's, which the strength comparison and the antennal lobe's normalization carried. Which estimate the base model takes comes before the setting of its antennal lobe, and is a choice still to be made.
- **The weak odors do not ask for the antennal lobe's price.** By the rule fixed beforehand the unchanged family's APL already takes the flies' share of the KCs there, and the weaker normalization moved the KCs at ma at 10^-7 further from the flies. Read like for like since, it moves them further in half of the combinations of set, condition and estimate, and nearer in the other half ([the KCs' response rates at the weak odors read like for like](#weak-odor-rates)).
- **What recruits the flies' KCs at weak input** stays the lead from the low concentrations ([the per-claw threshold at low concentration](#low-concentration)): the family has the share at response rates that are too low with APL on and with APL off. Read like for like since, whether they are too low turns on the session's estimate of the input, on the set of flies and on how a response is counted ([the KCs' response rates at the weak odors read like for like](#weak-odor-rates)).
- **For the experimenter.** More APL flies of the 2022 design beside KC flies would decide the fall, and flies of both genotypes at the weak odors would bound the flies' APL against the implied strength. Four questions on these recordings are open, on the fly of unsettled labelling, the leak, the vials and the quality, and none holds a class here.

### The KCs' response rates at the weak odors read like for like: whether the best family's KCs respond to weak input less than the flies' once the flies' three sets of recordings are kept apart, the solvent's responders are removed and each session's estimate of the input is read by itself, and what the antennal lobe's weaker normalization costs at low concentration on that reading {#weak-odor-rates}

%%% hover
evoked response rate: A recording's response rate to a stimulus minus its response rate to the solvent, counted in the same unit and over the same trials. The model's blank gives no response, so that its response rate is its evoked response rate. Defined in the subsection on the KCs' response rates at the weak odors read like for like.
trial-noise unit: A KC's mean response over the trials of a stimulus, divided by the standard deviation of its single trials around the means of their own stimuli, pooled over the recording's stimuli. A response is a value above the criterion at which the control flies of the 16-odor panel have the response rate that they have at 1 z. It stands in for baseline-noise units where the traces are not on hand. Defined in the subsection on the KCs' response rates at the weak odors read like for like.
%%%

**The goal was to learn whether the best family's KCs respond to weak input less than the flies' do.** The KCs at weak input were the one place where the family looked short of the flies' KCs. To ma at 10^-7, {{E49/data_fractions.csv:panel=diag_mix;group=control;odor=ma @ -7:frac ~ .3f}} of the KCs respond in control flies and {{E49/data_fractions.csv:panel=diag_mix;group=apl_output_blocked;odor=ma @ -7:frac ~ .3f}} with APL output blocked (TNT), against {{E72/low_conc/fractions.csv:model=c2_68;odor=ma @ -7;cond=on:frac_det ~ .3f}} with APL on and {{E72/low_conc/fractions.csv:model=c2_68;odor=ma @ -7;cond=acute_off:frac_det ~ .3f}} with APL off in the family's fit on the real wiring ([the APL-effect fit on re-drawn wirings](#wiring-population)).

**Two later readings left that as a lead.** What recruits the flies' KCs at weak input was carried from both ([the antennal lobe's normalization at the strength the flies' APL asks for](#al-normalization); [the flies' KCs beside their APL along concentration](#kc-calyx-vs-apl)). The first of them also counted the KCs lost at low concentration as a cost of a weaker antennal lobe.

**That comparison was not like for like in four ways.** Here it is read again with each of the four kept apart. No model is changed, and nothing is fitted or scored on [the APL-effect loss](#apl-effect), whose mean part and pattern part stay where they are.

- The family's value came from one of three sessions' estimates of the weak odors' input, the lowest of the three.
- The control flies' value pooled two periods of recordings.
- The flies' response rates counted the KCs that respond to the solvent.
- The flies had six trials at the weak odors, where the 16-odor panel has three.

**The family is short against one set of flies under one estimate.** Against the earliest of the flies' three sets of recordings, with APL on and the lowest estimate of the input, fewer of the family's KCs respond than of the flies', under every further reading. Under the other two estimates the family is inside that set's interval, and against the two later sets it is not short under any estimate.

**The verdict turns on four things.** They are the session whose estimate of the input is taken, the set of flies, how a response is counted, and whether APL is on. The shortfall carried so far is thus mostly the comparison's. The flies' level at weak input is known to no better than the factor of about three between their sets.

**The antennal lobe's cost at low concentration does not stand like for like.** At the picked step of the weaker normalization, the family's KCs at ma move further from the flies in half of the combinations of set, condition and estimate, and nearer in the other half.

**One caveat goes with every reading with APL off.** The unit in which the flies' responses are counted here passes its check on the control flies of the 16-odor panel. On that panel's flies with APL output blocked (TNT) it fails, and undercounts their responders. With APL off the family is therefore set against a level of the flies that is too low.

**The recordings.** The low-concentration KC recordings ([the per-claw threshold at low concentration](#low-concentration)) are read as three sets of flies that are never pooled. The experimenter who made them has not checked their quality.

- **The first set:** the recordings of the diagnostic odors and their mixtures made until February 2025, {{E105/p0_counts.csv:set=D1;group=control:n_recordings ~ .0f}} recordings of {{E105/p0_counts.csv:set=D1;group=control:n_flies ~ .0f}} control flies. The only flies with APL output blocked (TNT) are of this set, {{E105/p0_counts.csv:set=D1;group=apl_output_blocked:n_recordings ~ .0f}} recordings of {{E105/p0_counts.csv:set=D1;group=apl_output_blocked:n_flies ~ .0f}} flies.
- **The second set:** the same stimuli recorded from March 2025, {{E105/p0_counts.csv:set=D2;group=control:n_recordings ~ .0f}} recordings of {{E105/p0_counts.csv:set=D2;group=control:n_flies ~ .0f}} control flies.
- **The third set:** recordings of dilute natural mixtures made in January and February 2026, {{E105/p0_counts.csv:set=N;group=control:n_recordings ~ .0f}} recordings of {{E105/p0_counts.csv:set=N;group=control:n_flies ~ .0f}} control flies, with ma and 2h at 10^-7 and without farn.

**How a fly's response is counted.** The traces of these recordings are not on hand, so that [baseline-noise units](#fn-baseline-noise-units) cannot be used. The main reading counts a response in the trial-noise unit, above a criterion of {{lit:1.9338545203208923 # results/E105_weak_odor_rates/p0_cstar.json (a JSON file, which the filler does not read): cstar, the criterion in the trial-noise unit at which the control flies of the 16-odor panel have their response rate at 1 z ~ .2f}} of its standard deviations, and takes the evoked response rate over all trials. A set's value is the mean over its flies, with an interval over resampled flies. The flies with APL output blocked (TNT) are too few for an interval of their own, and take the relative width of the first set's control flies'.

**The family's side.** The best family is read at its fits on the eight wirings, with nothing set again ([the APL-effect fit on re-drawn wirings](#wiring-population)); a response is two spikes or more. Each weak odor's input is taken in turn from the diagnostic odors of each of the three sessions of ORN recordings. ma's input is at the flies' concentration. 2h's is at 10^-6 and farn's at 10^-2, one log unit above the flies' ([ORN input at another concentration](#fn-concentrations)).

**The three estimates of the input differ.** An odor's total input differs between the sessions by a factor of {{E105/d1_factors.csv:set=D1;condition=on;estimate=kiwi-control;odor=ma:sessions_factor_max ~ .1f}} for ma, {{E105/d1_factors.csv:set=D1;condition=on;estimate=kiwi-control;odor=2h:sessions_factor_max ~ .1f}} for 2h and {{E105/d1_factors.csv:set=D1;condition=on;estimate=kiwi-control;odor=farn:sessions_factor_max ~ .1f}} for farn. The mixture session's is the lowest for all three, and it is the one with which the family had been run on these odors before.

**The classes were fixed before any was computed.** The definitions, the lists of recordings and the thresholds were committed first. At a stimulus the family is short if at least six of the eight wirings lie below the flies' interval, over if six lie above, and inside if six lie inside or, failing these, their median does.

**The verdict.** For a set, a condition and an estimate the verdict is short if ma is short, or if 2h and farn both are. It is not short if ma is inside or over and 2h and farn are not both short. ma decides because its input is at the flies' concentration.

**When a verdict is held.** A verdict is held only if the main reading and each of six further readings give it. No rule lets one estimate or one set suffice. The further readings are:

- A response counted at 1 z, the recordings' own criterion, in place of the trial-noise unit.
- The first three trials alone.
- The experimenter's definition of a response, above 1 z on at least half of the trials.
- One spike or more as the family's response.
- Each side taken over its own response rate to the 16-odor panel.
- Each control fly of the set left out in turn.

ma at 10^-7 in the flies and in the best family, set by set. Flies: the evoked response rate as the mean over flies, with the interval over resampled flies under the main reading. Family: the median of the eight wirings' response rates and its class against the flies' interval under the main reading. With APL off the family is set against the flies with APL output blocked (TNT), whose responders the trial-noise unit undercounts

Each panel: for each odor, with the flies' concentration below it, the flies' value (grey line) with its interval (band), the eight wirings' response rates (dots) and their median (black bar) with the odor's input from the mixture session (blue; kiwi-control in the legend), the megamat session (orange) and the validation2 session (green), and each class below the dots. Top row: the comparison as it had been read, with the two periods pooled, a response counted at 1 z and the solvent's responders kept. The other rows: the main reading.](results/E105_weak_odor_rates/E105_cells.png)

**Read as before, the family is short everywhere.** With the two periods pooled, a response counted at 1 z, the solvent's responders kept and the mixture session's estimate, the family is short at all three odors, with APL on and with APL off (the figure, top row).

**Read like for like, it is short against the first set under the mixture session's estimate.** With APL on the family is short there at ma and at 2h, and the verdict is held under every further reading. Under the megamat and the validation2 sessions' estimates it is inside the first set's interval at both odors (the table).

**Against the two later sets it is not short under any estimate.** Their control flies respond to ma less than the first set's (the table). Against both, the family is inside at ma under the mixture session's estimate and over under the validation2 session's. At 2h it is short under the mixture session's estimate against these sets as well, which by the rule does not make the verdict short while ma is inside.

**The sets of flies differ at ma about threefold.** Counted at 1 z, the first set's control flies respond to ma {{E105/a2_sets.csv:unit=z1;measure=evoked;stimulus=ma @ -7;set_a=D1;set_b=D2:ratio ~ .1f}} times as much as the second set's ({{E105/a2_sets.csv:unit=z1;measure=evoked;stimulus=ma @ -7;set_a=D1;set_b=D2:ratio_lo90 ~ .1f}} to {{E105/a2_sets.csv:unit=z1;measure=evoked;stimulus=ma @ -7;set_a=D1;set_b=D2:ratio_hi90 ~ .1f}}) and {{E105/a2_sets.csv:unit=z1;measure=evoked;stimulus=ma @ -7;set_a=D1;set_b=N:ratio ~ .1f}} times as much as the third set's ({{E105/a2_sets.csv:unit=z1;measure=evoked;stimulus=ma @ -7;set_a=D1;set_b=N:ratio_lo90 ~ .1f}} to {{E105/a2_sets.csv:unit=z1;measure=evoked;stimulus=ma @ -7;set_a=D1;set_b=N:ratio_hi90 ~ .1f}}). By the rule on the ways of dividing their flies the sets differ there. In the trial-noise unit the first and the second set differ as well, and the first and the third do not. At 2h and at farn the first set differs from neither above the solvent.

**The trials that are read change the flies' level.** In the two sets with six trials the flies respond more on their first three trials than over all six, in the first set about twice as much (the table). The third set, with two to four trials, shows no such difference. The family's matched trial noise, read on the real wiring, makes no such fall over trials, and no responders to the blank.

**Beside, at the other stimulus whose input is at the flies' concentration, the family is short.** To 2h at 10^-5, which only the third set has, {{E105/a4_beside.csv:odor=2h:flies_value ~ .3f}} of the flies' KCs respond above the solvent ({{E105/a4_beside.csv:odor=2h:flies_lo90 ~ .3f}} to {{E105/a4_beside.csv:odor=2h:flies_hi90 ~ .3f}}), and {{E105/a4_beside.csv:odor=2h:median ~ .3f}} of the family's at the median, below the interval on all {{E105/a4_beside.csv:odor=2h:n_below ~ .0f}} wirings. That stimulus has one session's estimate of the input and {{E105/a4_beside.csv:odor=2h:flies_n_flies ~ .0f}} flies, and no verdict rests on it.

**Held short once, and held not short three times.** Of the {{lit:12 # results/E105_weak_odor_rates/a3_held.csv: the number of rows, one for each set, condition and estimate}} combinations the verdict is held short in {{lit:1 # results/E105_weak_odor_rates/a3_held.csv: the number of rows whose held is short}}, held not short in {{lit:3 # results/E105_weak_odor_rates/a3_held.csv: the number of rows whose held is not short}} and not held in {{lit:8 # results/E105_weak_odor_rates/a3_held.csv: the number of rows whose held is not held}} (the table). It turns on four things:

- **The estimate of the input.** Against the first set with APL on it is short under the mixture session's estimate and not short under the other two.
- **The set of flies.** Under the mixture session's estimate with APL on it is short against the first set and not short against the second and the third.
- **How a response is counted.** Counted at 1 z, on the first three trials or by the experimenter's definition, the first set with APL on is short under every estimate.
- **The condition.** Within the first set under the mixture session's estimate it is short with APL on and not short with APL off, which is where the caveat on the unit bears.

**The unit passes its check on the control flies and fails beside on the flies with APL output blocked (TNT).** The check fixed beforehand was on the control flies of the 16-odor panel, where both units can be computed. Their response rates to the 16 odors in the trial-noise unit had to lie within {{lit:0.010 # experiments/E105_lock.json (definitions fixed before any class was computed): response, unit_check, tol_rms}} of those in baseline-noise units, as a root mean square, and they do. On that panel's flies with APL output blocked (TNT), read beside, the difference is several times that tolerance (the table).

The unit's check on the recordings of the 16-odor panel: in the control flies, on which the check was fixed, and beside in the flies with APL output blocked (TNT). The response rates are over the panel's 16 odors

**Why the unit fails there.** The standard deviation that the unit divides by includes the trial-to-trial spread of strong responses, of which the flies with APL output blocked (TNT) have more. Their responders are therefore undercounted in the trial-noise unit, and at 1 z they are not: of the two, 1 z is the one that agrees with baseline-noise units on both genotypes (the table).

**What the caveat touches.** Every reading with APL off under the main reading sets the family against a level of the flies that is too low. Counted at 1 z, the first set's flies with APL output blocked (TNT) respond to ma at {{E105/a1_flies.csv:set=D1;group=apl_output_blocked;stimulus=ma @ -7;measure=evoked;unit=z1;trials=all:value ~ .3f}} in place of {{E105/a1_flies.csv:set=D1;group=apl_output_blocked;stimulus=ma @ -7;measure=evoked;unit=trial_noise;trials=all:value ~ .3f}}, and with APL off the family turns short under the mixture session's estimate. The verdict would then no longer differ between the conditions there. The rules stand as fixed: the reading at 1 z is reported, and not adopted.

**The antennal lobe's cost at low concentration was read again.** A weaker normalization in the antennal lobe had been found to take KCs from ma at 10^-7, further from the flies in both conditions ([the antennal lobe's normalization at the strength the flies' APL asks for](#al-normalization)). Its saved runs on the eight wirings were set against each set of flies under each estimate. A step moves the family further if the median wiring's distance from the flies' value, on the log scale, is {{lit:1.25 # experiments/E105_lock.json (definitions fixed before any class was computed): part_b, further}} times that of the unchanged fits or more, and nearer at {{lit:0.8 # experiments/E105_lock.json (definitions fixed before any class was computed): part_b, nearer}} times or less.

ma at 10^-7 at the picked step of the antennal lobe's weaker normalization. First four rows: the median of the eight wirings' response rates, as fitted and at the picked step at fixed scales. **At the picked step the cost holds in half of the combinations.** At ma the family moves further from the flies in {{lit:6 # results/E105_weak_odor_rates/b_e102_class.csv: step inhadd1000, odor ma: the number of the 12 rows whose e102_class is further (also the length of further_under in b_summary.json)}} of the {{lit:12 # results/E105_weak_odor_rates/b_e102_class.csv: step inhadd1000, odor ma: the number of rows, one for each set, condition and estimate (n_combinations in b_summary.json)}} combinations and nearer in the other {{lit:6 # results/E105_weak_odor_rates/b_e102_class.csv: step inhadd1000, odor ma: the number of the 12 rows whose e102_class is nearer}}. By that experiment's own rule, a fixed difference on the log scale, {{lit:5 # results/E105_weak_odor_rates/b_e102_class.csv: step inhadd1000, odor ma: the number of the 12 rows whose e102_own_rule is further}} are further. Under either rule the cost holds only against some sets under some estimates.

**Where it holds and where it reverses.** The step moves the family further from the first set with APL on under every estimate, from the first set with APL off under the mixture session's, and from the third set under the mixture and the megamat sessions'. It brings the family nearer where the unchanged fits lie above the flies: against the second set under every estimate, against the first set with APL off under the megamat and the validation2 sessions', and against the third set under the validation2 session's.

**The four refits read alike.** Fitted again at the picked step on the four wirings of the earlier searches, the family is further from the first set's control flies at ma under every estimate, and nearer or level against the second set. Against the third set and with APL off the refits are mixed. Four wirings give a description, and no level, class or price of that experiment changes.

**The flies' ratio was read within one set.** The share that APL takes of the flies' KCs had been read from the flies with APL output blocked (TNT) over the control flies of both periods pooled ([the flies' KCs beside their APL along concentration](#kc-calyx-vs-apl)). All flies with APL output blocked (TNT) are of the first set, so that the ratio is taken here against that set's control flies alone, by the rules of that comparison.

**Within the first set the flies' ratio at ma is smaller, and the family's own APL is too strong for it.** At 2h and at farn the family's own APL stays inside the implied strength. At ma the ratio is smaller than the pooled one, and the family's own APL is too strong for it under every estimate of the input, where one estimate had given inside before (the table). The rules of that comparison ask for two of the three odors, so that its verdict stays inside, and its verdicts stand as they were fixed.

**How much input the family would need was read beside.** At fixed parameters each estimate's input was multiplied by a common factor of {{lit:0.5 # experiments/E105_lock.json (definitions fixed before any class was computed): part_d, factors, the smallest}} to {{lit:4 # experiments/E105_lock.json (definitions fixed before any class was computed): part_d, factors, the largest}} on every glomerulus, on the eight wirings. The factor at which the family's response rate meets the flies' says how far the family is from each set in units of input. No class rests on these runs.

ma at 10^-7: each session's total input as a multiple of the lowest, and the factor on that input at which the family's response rate meets the flies' evoked response rate under the main reading, as the median over the eight wirings. A factor above one means that the family needs more input than the session gives. In the second set's last cell most wirings are still above the flies at the smallest factor run. The row with APL off is read against flies whose responders the trial-noise unit undercounts

**The input that the family lacks is about the factor between the sessions.** Against the first set's control flies the family needs the mixture session's input for ma raised by about the largest factor between the sessions' totals, and about the input that the other two sessions give as it is (the table). Against the second set the family needs less input than any session gives.

**Read as the recordings were made, the family is short against the first set under every estimate.** Under the per-KC reading ([the per-KC normalization of the recordings](#per-kc-normalization)), with each set's own session of stimuli and a response above 1 z on both sides, the family's response rate to ma with APL on is {{E105/d2_cells.csv:set=D1;condition=on;estimate=kiwi-control;rule=as_blank;map=linear;stimulus=ma @ -7;measure=evoked_z:median ~ .3f}}, {{E105/d2_cells.csv:set=D1;condition=on;estimate=megamat;rule=as_blank;map=linear;stimulus=ma @ -7;measure=evoked_z:median ~ .3f}} and {{E105/d2_cells.csv:set=D1;condition=on;estimate=validation2;rule=as_blank;map=linear;stimulus=ma @ -7;measure=evoked_z:median ~ .3f}} under the three estimates. The first set's control flies have {{E105/d2_cells.csv:set=D1;condition=on;estimate=kiwi-control;rule=as_blank;map=linear;stimulus=ma @ -7;measure=evoked_z:flies_value ~ .3f}} ({{E105/d2_cells.csv:set=D1;condition=on;estimate=kiwi-control;rule=as_blank;map=linear;stimulus=ma @ -7;measure=evoked_z:flies_lo90 ~ .3f}} to {{E105/d2_cells.csv:set=D1;condition=on;estimate=kiwi-control;rule=as_blank;map=linear;stimulus=ma @ -7;measure=evoked_z:flies_hi90 ~ .3f}}). That agrees with the further reading at 1 z. Against the two later sets the family is inside under the mixture session's estimate, as under the main reading.

**Realism.** No model was changed or fitted, so that no variant is scored on the main target. The eight fits are read as saved, and all are inside the four realism bands: their response rate with APL on is {{E105/a_realism.csv:wiring=real:rate_on ~ .3f}} to {{E105/a_realism.csv:wiring=P3:rate_on ~ .3f}} for the control flies' {{data:noise_ctrl_frac ~ .3f}}, and their ratio of APL off over APL on {{E105/a_realism.csv:wiring=P4:ratio ~ .2f}} to {{E105/a_realism.csv:wiring=P2:ratio ~ .2f}} for the flies' {{data:noise_rate_ratio_fraction ~ .2f}}.

**The runs with the input scaled are not variants of the family.** They are oracles on the input's size at fixed thresholds, and no band is read on them; the largest spike count in them is {{E105/variants.csv:D_P1:max_count_off ~ .0f}}, for {{E105/a_realism.csv:wiring=M2:max_count_weak_off ~ .0f}} at the weak stimuli as fitted. What the experiment adds beside the bands is that at the weak odors the family's KCs lie, under most readings, within the spread of the flies' three sets and not below it.

**Limits.** What the readings rest on:

- The experimenter has not checked the quality of these recordings. A question on what separates the two periods, on the solvent's responders and on runs to leave out is open, and holds no class here.
- The trial-noise unit undercounts the responders of the flies with APL output blocked (TNT), so that every reading with APL off under the main reading carries that caveat. The traces of the weak-odor recordings would allow baseline-noise units.
- There are {{E105/p0_counts.csv:set=D1;group=apl_output_blocked:n_flies ~ .0f}} flies with APL output blocked (TNT), with a borrowed interval that is wide at farn. Their block lasts the fly's life, and is set against the model's acute removal of APL.
- 2h and farn enter the model with ORN input recorded one log unit above the flies' concentration ([ORN input at another concentration](#fn-concentrations)). For those two a short is safe, and an inside may be the input's. paa, euc and -aPine are not involved.
- The ORN input is from other flies and sessions than the KC recordings, and the flies' z-scored responses of a nuclear indicator are set against spike counts.
- Some classes rest on the median of the eight wirings, where no six of them agree.

**What follows.** Nothing is gained or lost on the main target, and no base, bound or reference family is changed. Seven things are carried from here:

- **The shortfall at weak input is mostly the comparison's.** Read like for like, the family is short of the flies against one set under one session's estimate of the input, and inside or over elsewhere. The lead on what recruits the flies' KCs at weak input rests on that estimate and on that set.
- **No recruitment mechanism is planned while the verdict turns on the estimate and on the set.** That reading of these outcomes was fixed beforehand. The weak-odor recordings are, for now, neither a constraint that the family meets nor one that it fails.
- **The estimate of the input.** The mixture session's diagnostic odors give the lowest input of the three, and what the family lacks under it is about the factor between the sessions. That goes, as a description, beside the choice of the base model's input, which is still to be made; no estimate is recommended here. ORN recordings of 2h and ma at 10^-7 and of farn at 10^-3, in several flies of one session, would decide.
- **The set of flies.** The flies' level at ma differs about threefold between the sets, so that no mechanism is planned on one set, and every ratio with APL output blocked (TNT) is read within the first. What separates the two periods is a question to the experimenter. Recordings with APL output blocked (TNT) in the later design are the data to ask for.
- **How a response is counted.** The unit and the trials that are read change the verdict against the first two sets. The traces of the weak-odor recordings would settle the unit, in both genotypes. Until then a response at 1 z is the count that agrees with baseline-noise units on both genotypes of the 16-odor panel.
- **APL at weak input.** Within the first set the flies' ratio at ma is small, and the family's own APL is too strong for it under every estimate. That is a lead on APL's strength at weak input, beside the implied strength, and not on recruitment. The difference between the conditions under the main reading carries the caveat on the unit.
- **The antennal lobe's cost at low concentration** holds against the first set with APL on, and against the third set under the mixture and the megamat sessions' estimates. It reverses against the second set. That goes, as a description, beside the choice of the antennal lobe's setting, which is still to be made.

### The flies' APL at the weak odors and at the panel's concentrations: whether the best family's APL responds to weak odors, and across odors at the panel's concentration, as the flies' APL does, where in the calyx the flies' APL responds, and whether the wiring of two brains predicts its maps {#apl-weak-odors}

**The goal was to carry the comparison of APL's strength to stimuli that the first could not reach.** Over the one log unit of paa that the first recordings held, the best family's APL is flatter than the flies' ([the strength of APL's response in the flies against the model's APL](#apl-strength)). Further recordings of APL alone hold weak odors, pa, paa and ms at the panel's concentration, and APL's maps of both. No model is changed, and nothing is scored on [the APL-effect loss](#apl-effect), whose mean part and pattern part stay where they are.

**At the weak odors the family is inside the flies' interval by the rule, and flatter when read in proportion.** Of six weak stimuli, each as a ratio over paa at 10^-3, the family is inside at {{lit:four # results/E100_apl_weak_odors/verdict.json, W1_classes: the stimuli classed inside (2h @ -6, ma @ -7, 4h-ol @ -6 and farn @ -2)}} and flatter at {{lit:two # results/E100_apl_weak_odors/verdict.json, W1_classes: the stimuli classed flatter (2-but @ -6 and paa @ -5)}}, under every reading that the measurement leaves open. Two lenient clauses of the rule carry that class: the steeper readings of the indicator count, and one session's estimate of the input suffices. Read in proportion, the family's APL keeps more than half of its response at every weak stimulus, and the flies' APL less than half at all of them but farn.

**Across odors at the panel's concentration nothing is decided.** That comparison is held by {{E100/score_weak_table.csv:set=S;stimulus=paa @ -3:n_flies ~ .0f}} flies, {{E100/score_weak_table.csv:set=S;stimulus=ms @ -3:n_flies ~ .0f}} of them with ms, where the rule asked for four.

**The wiring of two brains gives no test of APL's maps.** Maps predicted from where the PN boutons lie agree between the hemibrain and the male CNS above chance. One calyx's map still does not carry over to a single plane of another calyx well enough for a recorded fly to be tested against it. By the rule fixed beforehand the test is therefore read on no pair of odors.

**One pattern for the whole calyx holds less of APL's maps at weak input, in some of the recordings.** {{lit:Two # results/E100_apl_weak_odors/verdict.json: f_common_share_weak_vs_panel, the sets with lower_at_weak true, counted (W and S; false in H)}} of the three sets of recordings show it and the third does not, so that it is a lead on how far a single APL can be carried to weak odors, and not a verdict.

**The recordings.** Three sets are read, by the experimenter who made the earlier maps: calcium in APL in one plane through the calyx, {{lit:99 # results/E100_apl_weak_odors/b_summary.json: n_recordings, the sum over the three sets (W 23, S 29, H 47)}} recordings in all. She has released every recording that she has processed, and has not checked their quality.

- **The weak-odor recordings of APL,** made in January 2025: {{lit:23 # results/E100_apl_weak_odors/b_summary.json: n_recordings, W}} recordings of {{lit:9 # results/E100_apl_weak_odors/b_summary.json: n_flies, W}} flies. The odors are weak by design: 2h, ma, 4h-ol, farn and 2-but at low concentrations, at which each drives one glomerulus more than any other, and ms and paa far below the panel's concentrations. Of the recordings, {{E100/score_weak_table.csv:set=W;stimulus=2h @ -6:n_recordings ~ .0f}} also hold paa at 10^-3, the concentration of the panel's KC recordings, which ties the weak odors to the panel.
- **The flies of 2022** ([the flies' APL across odors in the held-out vial series](#apl-held-out)): {{lit:29 # results/E100_apl_weak_odors/b_summary.json: n_recordings, S}} recordings of {{lit:3 # results/E100_apl_weak_odors/b_summary.json: n_flies, S}} flies, with pa, paa and ms in whole log steps up to 10^-3 and beyond.
- **A series of 2h and ma along concentration,** made from December 2021 to January 2022: {{lit:47 # results/E100_apl_weak_odors/b_summary.json: n_recordings, H}} recordings of {{lit:13 # results/E100_apl_weak_odors/b_summary.json: n_flies, H}} flies. It is described and decides nothing.

A fourth set, a single fly with all 16 odors of the panel at the panel's concentrations, exists only as movies that have not been processed, and is not read.

**What was read, and by which rules.** The rules of the strength comparison hold ([above](#apl-strength)): a response averaged inside the outline of the calyx, two stimuli compared as a ratio within a fly, the interval in which nine in ten resamplings of the flies fall, the fits of the eight wirings as saved, and the model's ratio read through the family of indicator nonlinearities. Four things differ:

- **The calyx response** is taken from the experimenter's own table of calyx responses. In the check fixed for the start, the mean taken from her maps came out a few percent below her table, so that it is read beside: it is {{lit:0.9598 # results/E100_apl_weak_odors/b_summary.json: map_over_yang_median, S (the lowest of the three sets) ~ .2f}} to {{lit:0.9675 # results/E100_apl_weak_odors/b_summary.json: map_over_yang_median, W (the highest of the three sets) ~ .2f}} of her table's at the median and gives the same classes.
- **The solvent.** In the weak-odor recordings of APL a response is taken minus the mean response to the solvent in the same recording. The mean over flies is arithmetic there, since a weak response can lie at or below the solvent's.
- **The input.** Each of the six weak stimuli has ORN input at the recorded concentration, in the diagnostic odors of each of the three sessions of ORN recordings. A ratio is inside if it is inside under any session's estimate, and outside only if it is outside under all three.
- **The verdicts.** At the weak odors the family is flatter than the flies, inside their interval or steeper if at least four of the six ratios over paa at 10^-3 are, and the comparison is not decided otherwise. Across odors, ms over pa and paa over pa at 10^-3 are decided only with four or more flies.

Ratios of APL's response to two stimuli in the flies and in the best family. Flies: the mean over the flies, with the interval over resampled flies and the number of flies in parentheses. Family: the range over the eight wirings and the sessions' estimates of the input with the indicator read in proportion, and the range over every reading of the indicator.

The class by the rule is taken over the estimates and through every reading of the indicator, and the class in proportion decides nothing. The last column names the sessions under whose estimate alone the family is inside by the rule. The first six rows carry the verdict at the weak odors, and the last two are the comparison across odors, which too few flies hold. A single row's class is a lead

**By the rule the family is inside.** {{lit:Four # results/E100_apl_weak_odors/verdict.json, W1_classes: the stimuli classed inside (2h @ -6, ma @ -7, 4h-ol @ -6 and farn @ -2)}} of the six ratios are inside and {{lit:two # results/E100_apl_weak_odors/verdict.json, W1_classes: the stimuli classed flatter (2-but @ -6 and paa @ -5)}} flatter. Every reading that the measurement leaves open gives the same six classes: the model's level just before the odor in place of the blank's, the calyx mean from the maps, the solvent of the block in place of the recording's, the recordings without those with a large response to the solvent, and the recordings with a 1 s pulse alone. Flatter had been judged the likelier outcome.

**The class rests on the rule's lenient clauses.** At the six weak stimuli the flies' APL keeps {{E100/score_weak_table.csv:set=W;stimulus=paa @ -5:flies_ratio ~ .2f}} to {{E100/score_weak_table.csv:set=W;stimulus=farn @ -2:flies_ratio ~ .2f}} of its response to paa at 10^-3, and the family's {{E100/score_weak_table.csv:set=W;stimulus=4h-ol @ -6:family_linear_min_blank ~ .2f}} to {{E100/score_weak_table.csv:set=W;stimulus=farn @ -2:family_linear_max_blank ~ .2f}} read in proportion. At ma and at 4h-ol the family reaches the flies' interval only through the steeper readings of the indicator, as it does at 2h on most wirings. Read in proportion the family is flatter at {{lit:four # results/E100_apl_weak_odors/verdict.json: W1_linear_beside, classes: the stimuli classed flatter, counted (ma @ -7, 4h-ol @ -6, 2-but @ -6 and paa @ -5); farn @ -2 is inside and 2h @ -6 reading-dependent; W1 reads flatter}} of the six, inside at farn and not decided at 2h, which by the same count reads flatter.

**It also turns on the session's estimate of the input.** With the mixture session's estimates alone the family is inside at {{lit:four # results/E100_apl_weak_odors/verdict.json: W1_lines, carrying, per_estimate, kiwi-control/diag: the stimuli inside, counted (2h @ -6, ma @ -7, 4h-ol @ -6 and farn @ -2)}} of the six. With the megamat session's it is inside at {{lit:three # results/E100_apl_weak_odors/verdict.json: W1_lines, carrying, per_estimate, megamat/diag: the stimuli inside, counted (2h @ -6, 4h-ol @ -6 and farn @ -2)}} and flatter at {{lit:three # results/E100_apl_weak_odors/verdict.json: W1_lines, carrying, per_estimate, megamat/diag: the stimuli flatter, counted (ma @ -7, 2-but @ -6 and paa @ -5)}}, which decides nothing, and with the validation2 session's it is flatter at {{lit:four # results/E100_apl_weak_odors/verdict.json: W1_lines, carrying, per_estimate, validation2/diag: the stimuli flatter, counted (ma @ -7, 4h-ol @ -6, 2-but @ -6 and paa @ -5)}}. ma is inside under the mixture session's estimate only. A single odor's class is a lead, with no check on other flies.

**Beside the verdict along concentration.** The direction is the same as over the log unit of paa: read in proportion, the family's APL keeps its strength at weak input where the flies' APL loses it. There the class was held through every reading of the indicator, and here it is not. No second verdict of flatter is therefore added, and the outcome that would have made a drive of APL that scales with the input a proposal is not reached.

**Across odors at the panel's concentration.** In the flies of 2022 ms evokes {{E100/score_weak_table.csv:set=S;stimulus=ms @ -3:flies_ratio ~ .2f}} of the response to pa at 10^-3, and the family's ms {{E100/score_weak_table.csv:set=S;stimulus=ms @ -3:family_linear_min_blank ~ .2f}} to {{E100/score_weak_table.csv:set=S;stimulus=ms @ -3:family_linear_max_blank ~ .2f}} read in proportion (last two rows of the table). The family is inside the flies' interval under {{lit:one # results/E100_apl_weak_odors/verdict.json: W2, ms/pa, line, carrying, per_estimate: the estimates under which the family is inside, counted (kiwi-control/diag; flatter under kiwi-control/control, megamat/diag, megamat/megamat and validation2/diag)}} of the five estimates of ms's input, and there only through the steeper readings of the indicator. For paa over pa {{lit:5 # results/E100_apl_weak_odors/verdict.json: W2, paa/pa, line, carrying, per_estimate, validation2/validation2 (not decided, 5 of 8 wirings inside)}} of the eight wirings are inside, which is not decided.

**Both are described and decide nothing.** The two ratios are held by {{E100/score_weak_table.csv:set=S;stimulus=ms @ -3:n_flies ~ .0f}} and by {{E100/score_weak_table.csv:set=S;stimulus=paa @ -3:n_flies ~ .0f}} flies. The flies of that year also differ from those of 2021 on ratios between odors by more than two vials of one odor make ([above](#apl-held-out)), so that the reading is given with its series.

**The third set sits higher.** In the series of 2h and ma, ma near 10^-7 evokes {{E100/score_ratio_classes.csv:set=H;a0_definition=blank;flies_reading=yang;stimulus=ma @ -7.248;reference=paa @ -3.431:flies_ratio ~ .2f}} of the response to paa, where the weak-odor recordings of APL give {{E100/score_weak_table.csv:set=W;stimulus=ma @ -7:flies_ratio ~ .2f}}, and 2h near 10^-6 {{E100/score_ratio_classes.csv:set=H;a0_definition=blank;flies_reading=yang;stimulus=2h @ -6.194;reference=paa @ -3.431:flies_ratio ~ .2f}} against {{E100/score_weak_table.csv:set=W;stimulus=2h @ -6:flies_ratio ~ .2f}}. The reference there is paa at 10^-3.4, and the flies are of three years earlier. A ratio between two odors read from one pair of vials is known to no better than a factor of about one and a half ([above](#apl-held-out)), so that the two sets need not disagree. Against that series the family is {{E100/score_ratio_classes.csv:set=H;a0_definition=blank;flies_reading=yang;stimulus=ma @ -7.248;reference=paa @ -3.431:held}} at both stimuli.

![The eight comparisons of the table, from top to bottom in its order; in the panel titles W1 and W2 are the verdict at the weak odors and the comparison across odors, set W the weak-odor recordings of APL and set S the flies of 2022. For each comparison: the flies' ratio (black line) with its interval over resampled flies (grey band) and, for each session's estimate of the input, the best family's ratio read in proportion on each of the eight wirings (dots) and its range over every reading of the indicator (line), with the class under that estimate and the number of wirings behind it at the right and the comparison's class in its title. In the labels kiwi-control is the mixture session, diag a session's diagnostic odors, kiwi-control/control that session's control panel, megamat/megamat the megamat panel and validation2/validation2 the validation2 panel. paa enters the model with ORN input recorded at 10^-4 for the flies' 10^-3.](results/E100_apl_weak_odors/E100_apl_ratios.png)

**Where in the calyx: the common pattern at weak input.** In the earlier maps most of a recording was one pattern common to all of its stimuli ([the APL calyx maps against the connectome](#apl-calyx-maps)). That pattern is the part of APL's activity that a single APL acting on the whole calyx alike, as the family's does, can describe. Here a map's share of it is the squared correlation of the map with the pattern common to the recording's other stimuli, divided by the map's reliability between presentations, so that a weak map does not read lower for being noisier.

The share of a stimulus's map that the common pattern holds, as the mean over flies, for the stimuli at the panel's concentrations and for the weak stimuli, with their difference and its interval over resampled flies. At the panel's concentrations: paa at 10^-3 in the weak-odor recordings of APL, and the panel's odors within one log unit of 10^-3 in the other two sets. Weak: the other stimuli of the weak-odor recordings of APL, and stimuli at 10^-5 or below in the other two sets
