**The common pattern holds less of a map at weak input in the weak-odor recordings of APL and in the flies of 2022.** In both the share is lower at the weak stimuli, with an interval above zero (the table). In the series of 2h and ma it is not. No rule over the sets had been fixed, so that this is a lead across sets and not a verdict.

**The solvent's map is mostly not the common pattern, and the remainder is the odor's.** The solvent's map resembles the common pattern as much as the odors' maps do in a minority of the recordings of every set (last row). What is left of a map without the common pattern repeats between a stimulus's presentations, at a Pearson r of {{lit:0.6517 # results/E100_apl_weak_odors/c_summary.json: per_set, W, shared_medians, mode means removed, blur_px 5.0, resid_repeat_r_median (the lowest of the three sets) ~ .2f}} to {{lit:0.8102 # results/E100_apl_weak_odors/c_summary.json: per_set, S, shared_medians, mode means removed, blur_px 5.0, resid_repeat_r_median (the highest of the three sets) ~ .2f}} over the sets, and not between odors ({{lit:-0.155 # results/E100_apl_weak_odors/c_summary.json: per_set, S, shared_medians, mode means removed, blur_px 5.0, resid_between_odor_r_median (the lowest of the three sets) ~ .2f}} to {{lit:0.0306 # results/E100_apl_weak_odors/c_summary.json: per_set, H, shared_medians, mode means removed, blur_px 5.0, resid_between_odor_r_median (the highest of the three sets) ~ .2f}}). That is as in the earlier maps and in the held-out series ([above](#apl-held-out)).

**Where single odors' responses lie, as leads.** At matched strength farn's response lies higher in the image than paa's in the weak-odor recordings of APL, in {{lit:7 # results/E100_apl_weak_odors/c_summary.json: per_set, W, centroid_y_offsets, offsets, offset_farn: n_flies minus n_flies_positive (7 minus 0), the flies in which farn's response lies higher in the image than paa's}} of {{lit:7 # results/E100_apl_weak_odors/c_summary.json: per_set, W, centroid_y_offsets, offsets, offset_farn, n_flies}} flies. In the series of 2h and ma, ma's lies lower than paa's in {{lit:12 # results/E100_apl_weak_odors/c_summary.json: per_set, H, centroid_y_offsets, offsets, offset_ma, n_flies_positive, the flies in which ma's response lies lower in the image than paa's}} of {{lit:12 # results/E100_apl_weak_odors/c_summary.json: per_set, H, centroid_y_offsets, offsets, offset_ma, n_flies}}. Dorsal is up in these images, and each reading rests on one set of flies.

**The maps predicted from the wiring, on three calyces.** The test of predicted against measured maps had been made from connectome tables whose use is on hold ([footnote](#fn-derived-tables)). It was made again on the hemibrain's right calyx and on the male CNS's two, from the hemibrain tables that the model reads and from tables of the male CNS made by the same pipeline. Nothing made from the held tables is used. For an odor each PN bouton contributes its number of release sites times the PN rate of its glomerulus ([how the maps were predicted and scored](#fn-calyx-maps)), and the difference between two weak odors is predicted for five pairs.

**The two brains agree above chance, and more than the two sides of one brain.** Over the five pairs, the three sessions' estimates of the input and three smoothings, the predicted difference maps of the hemibrain and of the male CNS correlate above the 95th percentile of the same with permuted glomerulus labels in {{lit:39 # results/E100_apl_weak_odors/a3_summary.json: agreement_n_above_null_p95, across brains (39 of 45, pair x estimate x blur)}} of {{lit:45 # results/E100_apl_weak_odors/a3_summary.json: agreement_n_above_null_p95 (5 pairs x 3 estimates x 3 blurs)}} cases. Those of the male CNS's two calyces do so in {{lit:17 # results/E100_apl_weak_odors/a3_summary.json: agreement_n_above_null_p95, across sides (17 of 45, pair x estimate x blur)}}.

**No pair has the power that the test asks for.** Before any measured map was scored against a prediction, the chance was worked out that a true wiring-based map would be detected in one plane: one calyx's predicted map as the truth, noise at the reliability of the measured maps, and another calyx's prediction as what is scored. Across the two brains that chance is {{E100/a4_power.csv:pair=2h @ -6 - farn @ -2;session=megamat;role=decisive (2021, paa minus ms);scoring=slabs;kind=across brains:power ~ .2f}} to {{E100/a4_power.csv:pair=2-but @ -6 - ma @ -7;session=validation2;role=decisive (2021, paa minus ms);scoring=slabs;kind=across brains:power ~ .2f}} on slabs near the imaged plane and {{E100/a4_power.csv:pair=2h @ -6 - farn @ -2;session=kiwi-control;role=decisive (2021, paa minus ms);scoring=whole;kind=across brains:power ~ .2f}} to {{E100/a4_power.csv:pair=4h-ol @ -6 - 2h @ -6;session=megamat;role=decisive (2021, paa minus ms);scoring=whole;kind=across brains:power ~ .2f}} on the whole calyx projected along its depth, at the lowest of the three estimates for each pair.

**The rule asked for more.** A pair needed a chance of {{lit:0.8 # results/E100_apl_weak_odors/a4_w3_pairs.json: power_min, fixed with the rule before the test was run}}, and at least three pairs had to reach it. Under no estimate does a pair exceed {{E100/a4_power.csv:pair=ma @ -7 - farn @ -2;session=validation2;role=decisive (2021, paa minus ms);scoring=slabs;kind=across brains:power ~ .2f}} on the slabs and {{E100/a4_power.csv:pair=4h-ol @ -6 - 2h @ -6;session=validation2;role=decisive (2021, paa minus ms);scoring=whole;kind=across brains:power ~ .2f}} on the projection. The test is therefore read on no pair, which had been judged the likeliest outcome.

**The limit lies between calyces and not in the noise.** Scored against its own prediction on the slabs, at the same noise, every pair is detected in every simulated recording. On the projection even a calyx's own prediction is detected in {{E100/a4_power.csv:pair=2h @ -6 - farn @ -2;session=kiwi-control;role=decisive (2021, paa minus ms);scoring=whole;kind=own calyx:power ~ .2f}} to {{E100/a4_power.csv:pair=4h-ol @ -6 - 2h @ -6;session=kiwi-control;role=decisive (2021, paa minus ms);scoring=whole;kind=own calyx:power ~ .2f}} of them at the lowest of the estimates, so that this way of scoring could not have kept a pair.

**The measured maps against the three calyces, described.** With no pair kept, the flies' maps decide nothing here. Read all the same, on all five pairs and both ways of scoring, no prediction beats the permuted labels in more than {{E100/d_pair_shares.csv:set=W;scoring=whole;pair=2h @ -6 - farn @ -2;session=validation2:share_malecns_R ~ .2f}} of the {{E100/d_pair_shares.csv:set=W;scoring=whole;pair=2h @ -6 - farn @ -2;session=validation2:n_recordings ~ .0f}} weak-odor recordings of APL in any calyx. For the earlier maps of pa, paa and ms, pa minus ms and paa minus ms do so in at most {{E100/d_pair_shares.csv:set=2021;scoring=slabs;pair=pa-ms (2021);session=apl16:share_hemibrain_R ~ .2f}} of the {{E100/d_pair_shares.csv:set=2021;scoring=slabs;pair=pa-ms (2021);session=apl16:n_recordings ~ .0f}} recordings.

![Left (A4 in the panel title): for each of the five pairs of weak odors and each of the two ways of scoring, the chance that a true wiring-based map is detected in one plane of another calyx: across the two brains (filled; the lowest over the three estimates of the input, with a line to the highest), across the male CNS's two sides (open) and for a calyx against its own prediction (grey diamond), with the chance that a pair needs (dashed). Right (part D in the panel title; set W is the weak-odor recordings of APL): the share of those recordings in which the prediction beats the permuted labels, in each of the three calyces, one marker for each estimate of the input, with the quarter and the half of the rule (dashed); it is described and decides nothing.](results/E100_apl_weak_odors/E100_maps_power.png)

**Realism.** No model was changed or fitted, so that no variant is scored on the main target. The fits of the eight wirings are read as saved, and all eight are inside the four realism bands.

**What the experiment adds beside the bands** is the family's APL at weak input. Read in proportion it keeps {{E100/score_weak_table.csv:set=W;stimulus=4h-ol @ -6:family_linear_min_blank ~ .2f}} to {{E100/score_weak_table.csv:set=W;stimulus=farn @ -2:family_linear_max_blank ~ .2f}} of its response to paa, while the family's own KCs lose far more: their response rate with APL on is {{E100/score_weak_table.csv:set=W;stimulus=paa @ -3:family_kc_on_median ~ .3f}} at paa and {{E100/score_weak_table.csv:set=W;stimulus=paa @ -5:family_kc_on_median ~ .3f}} to {{E100/score_weak_table.csv:set=W;stimulus=2h @ -6:family_kc_on_median ~ .3f}} at the six weak stimuli, as medians over the wirings and the estimates. Whether those KCs are short of the flies' turns on the estimate of the input and on the set of flies ([the KCs' response rates at the weak odors read like for like](#weak-odor-rates)).

**Limits.** What the readings rest on:

- The experimenter has not checked the quality of these recordings. How her table of calyx responses is computed is asked, and so is whether the vials of paa at 10^-3 and at 10^-5 were exchanged on one day of the weak-odor recordings of APL, whose recordings are read as their stimulus files say.
- paa enters the model with ORN input recorded at 10^-4, one log unit below the flies' 10^-3 ([ORN input at another concentration](#fn-concentrations)), so that every ratio of the first table is affected except ms over pa. Over farn at 10^-2, whose input is at the recorded concentration, the other weak stimuli are inside except 2-but, which is {{E100/score_ratio_classes.csv:set=W;a0_definition=blank;flies_reading=yang;stimulus=2-but @ -6;reference=farn @ -2:held}}. euc and -aPine are not involved.
- Of the {{lit:23 # results/E100_apl_weak_odors/b_summary.json: n_recordings, W}} weak-odor recordings of APL, {{lit:22 # results/E100_apl_weak_odors/b_recordings.csv: the rows of set W with pulse_s 1.0, counted (the other recording has 3.0)}} used a 1 s pulse, twice the model's. Those recordings alone give the same classes.
- The solvent's response is large in the weak-odor recordings of APL, {{lit:0.30910800065439786 # results/E100_apl_weak_odors/verdict.json: g_solvent_vs_common, W, solvent_share_of_largest_median ~ .2f}} of the recording's largest response at the median, and is subtracted there.
- The ratios here are between two stimuli read from one pair of vials, and such a ratio between two odors is known to no better than a factor of about one and a half ([above](#apl-held-out)).
- The class at the weak odors rests on the steeper readings of the indicator. The responses of the flies of 2022 are near the indicator's saturation, and no saturating form was read.
- The male CNS is a male brain, its two calyces are one fly's, and its tables hold synapses from a higher confidence than the hemibrain's. Two brains and three calyces are few for what flies share.
- Single odors' classes and the places of single odors' responses are leads: each rests on one set of flies, with no check on others.
- What calcium in one plane of APL is of the model's single APL variable is not known.

**What follows.** Nothing is gained or lost on the main target, and no base, bound or reference family is changed. Five things are carried from here:

- **The verdict along concentration stays the one held verdict of flatter.** At the weak odors the family is inside by the rule and flatter read in proportion, the direction of that verdict and of the dual-colour recordings ([above](#apl-vs-claws)). Which reading holds turns on how steeply the indicator in APL reports its activity, which these recordings do not say.
- **No drive of APL that scales with the input is proposed from here.** The outcome that would have made one a proposal was not reached, and what the candidates do has been read since. With a weaker normalization in the antennal lobe the two flatter stimuli come inside through the steeper readings of the indicator, and fewer KCs respond at the weakest odors ([above](#al-normalization)). The flies' KCs at three weak odors do not ask for an APL weaker than the family's ([above](#kc-calyx-vs-apl)).
- **Across odors at the panel's concentration** a verdict needs four or more flies with pa, paa and ms near 10^-3 in one design. Which flies' ms to trust is a question to the experimenter ([above](#apl-held-out)), and until it is answered the family is called neither too even nor too uneven across odors.
- **A spatially local APL has no test from the wiring in these tables.** How far the boutons' places in the calyx are shared between flies is the result: enough for two brains' maps to agree above chance, and not enough for a single plane of a third fly to be tested. The proposal keeps its measured object, the part of APL's map that is the odor's ([above](#apl-held-out)), and the test place by place against the claws stays undecided ([above](#apl-vs-claws)). What would give a test from the wiring is a volume of the recorded fly's own calyx, which goes with the data asked for at the end of the page.
- **One APL for the whole calyx at weak input.** A common pattern that holds less of APL's maps at weak odors bears on how far the family's single APL can be carried to the low-concentration KC recordings ([the per-claw threshold at low concentration](#low-concentration)). It is a lead while the third set does not show it, and nothing is fitted on it.

### The glomeruli's shares of the claws in another connectome: whether the error common to all wirings is in part the proportions of one fly's mushroom body {#claw-shares}

**The question was whether "common to all wirings" has meant "common to one fly's proportions".** Every wiring that the best family has been read on, the real wiring and seven re-draws of it ([the APL-effect fit on re-drawn wirings](#wiring-population)), gives each glomerulus the number of claws that it has in the hemibrain. The same was asked of the input, and nothing moved ([the ORN input as a population of flies](#input-population)). But the lab's input is a mean over flies, and the hemibrain is one fly.

**On two brains, the answer is no.** With the proportions of a second brain, the male CNS, put onto the eight wirings, the pattern part of [the APL-effect loss](#apl-effect) does not fall. At the two brains' mean proportions it rises a little, which by the rule fixed beforehand reads "worse". Much of that rise is what moving claws on a fitted wiring costs, whatever the direction. Neither ρ on odor-odor distances rises.

**The hemibrain's proportions stay.** No base, bound or family changes, and on the main target's account nothing here asks for a wiring of the male CNS in the model's format.

**How the proportions were read.** Both brains were read from tables of one source: the hemibrain tables that the model's loader reads, and tables of the male CNS made by the same pipeline. A claw is counted as the loader counts it, by five or more synapses from one PN of a single glomerulus. The same reader, run on the hemibrain's table of synapses, returned the model's wiring exactly ({{lit:9,867 # results/E97_glomerulus_claw_shares/a_summary.json, a1_rule.model_claws; identity.json: 0 differences from the model's wiring}} claws on {{lit:54 # results/E97_glomerulus_claw_shares/a_summary.json, a2.n_glomeruli}} glomeruli). The male CNS's left and right mushroom bodies were counted apart, at {{lit:10,077 # results/E97_glomerulus_claw_shares/a_summary.json, a1_rule.mbs.malecns_L.claws}} and {{lit:10,008 # results/E97_glomerulus_claw_shares/a_summary.json, a1_rule.mbs.malecns_R.claws}} claws on the same glomeruli.

**How they were put onto the wirings.** Within each type of KC, claws were moved between glomeruli until every glomerulus's total was the wiring's own times the other brain's ratio of shares. Every KC kept its type and its number of claws, and a moved claw kept its APL and KC–KC weights. Both response rates were then held at each wiring's own fit; nothing was fitted. Three sets of proportions were read: each side of the male CNS, and the mean of the two brains, the male CNS's sides averaged first.

**The two sides of one fly differ as much as the two brains.** On a scale of logarithms to base 2, a glomerulus's share in the male CNS differs from its share in the hemibrain with a standard deviation of {{E97/a2_spread.csv:mb=malecns_L;subset=all54:sd_log2 ~ .2f}} on the left and {{E97/a2_spread.csv:mb=malecns_R;subset=all54:sd_log2 ~ .2f}} on the right, and the two sides differ from each other with {{E97/a2_agreement.csv:mb_a=malecns_L;mb_b=malecns_R;subset=all;kind=two sides of one brain:sd_log2_ratio ~ .2f}}. The two sides' departures from the hemibrain correlate at {{E97/a2_agreement.csv:kind=log2 ratios to the hemibrain:r_log2_share ~ .2f}}. The mean proportions are a smaller change ({{E97/a2_spread.csv:mb=mean;subset=all54:sd_log2 ~ .2f}}; ratios of {{E97/a2_spread.csv:mb=mean;subset=all54:q05 ~ .2f}} to {{E97/a2_spread.csv:mb=mean;subset=all54:q95 ~ .2f}} for nine glomeruli in ten).

**Few claws move.** The mean proportions move {{E97/variants.csv:tag=B2_mean2_real:moved_share ~ .1%}} of a wiring's claws, the left side's {{E97/variants.csv:tag=B1_mcnsL_real:moved_share ~ .1%}} and the right side's {{E97/variants.csv:tag=B1_mcnsR_real:moved_share ~ .1%}}. The distances between odors in the claw-weighted ORN input keep their order.

**The verdicts were fixed beforehand.** On the pattern part through [the calibrated readout](#fn-calibrated-readout), the eight wirings read as one population against all recordings, a change within {{lit:0.0015 # NO_MOVE in experiments/E97_glomerulus_claw_shares.py}} either way is no move, a rise of that much or more is "worse", and a gain needs a fall of {{lit:0.003 # MOVE_8 in experiments/E97_glomerulus_claw_shares.py (the entry's outcome (b))}} that the controls do not share. On ρ on odor-odor distances a rise or a fall needs {{lit:0.010 # RHO_GAIN in experiments/E97_glomerulus_claw_shares.py}} on {{lit:6 # RHO_WIRINGS in experiments/E97_glomerulus_claw_shares.py}} of the eight wirings; that second verdict was added before any point was scored.

The eight wirings as one population through the calibrated readout, against all recordings. The controls move as many claws as the mean proportions: the mean's ratios permuted among the glomeruli (two draws) and inverted. The model flies are the eight wirings at each of the three mushroom bodies' proportions. Changes are from the wirings as they are. No setting is chosen by a correlation ([why](#fn-pattern-split)).

**At the two brains' mean proportions the pattern part is a little worse.** It rises from the eight wirings' {{E97/readings.csv:variant=ref;unit=all8;readout=cal:z8_pattern ~ .4f}} as they are to {{E97/readings.csv:variant=B2_mean2;unit=all8;readout=cal:z8_pattern ~ .4f}} (floor {{data:apl_effect_pattern_floor ~ .4f}}), beyond the threshold for "worse". The interval over resampled recordings lies above zero, both halves of the wirings rise, and so does the reading against each of four halves of the recordings (by {{E97/readings.csv:variant=B2_mean2;unit=all8;readout=cal:d_halfC_pattern ~ +.4f}} at the least). The rise is in the shape part; the spread of the effect and the mean APL effect stay where they were.

**The controls lose too.** The mean's ratios permuted among the glomeruli, and the ratios inverted, move as many claws and also raise the pattern part (table). The mean proportions sit at the top of the controls' range and not beyond it. So most of the rise reads as the cost of any move away from the wirings that the family was fitted on; a small cost of these proportions in particular is not excluded.

**The cost grows with the number of claws moved.** On the first four wirings the mean's ratios at half their size, as they are and at twice their size raise the pattern part by {{E97/readings.csv:variant=B5_mean2_x0.5;unit=S;readout=cal:d_z8_pattern ~ +.4f}}, {{E97/readings.csv:variant=B2_mean2;unit=S;readout=cal:d_z8_pattern ~ +.4f}} and {{E97/readings.csv:variant=B5_mean2_x2;unit=S;readout=cal:d_z8_pattern ~ +.4f}}, the number of claws moved doubling at each step. A second draw of which claws are moved, at the same proportions, gives {{E97/readings.csv:variant=B4_mean2_d2;unit=S;readout=cal:d_z8_pattern ~ +.4f}}. The size of the move predicts the cost about as well as its direction does.

**The two sides of the male CNS go opposite ways, by little.** The left side's proportions raise the pattern part and the right side's lower it slightly, with an interval below zero (table). The right side's gain is far short of the {{lit:0.003 # DISAGREE in experiments/E97_glomerulus_claw_shares.py}} at which the two sides would count as disagreeing, it comes with a lower mean APL effect, and single wirings are more often worse than better under it. Each side's own permuted control, one draw each, raises the pattern part by {{E97/readings.csv:variant=B3_perm_mcnsL_s1;unit=all8;readout=cal:d_z8_pattern ~ +.4f}} and {{E97/readings.csv:variant=B3_perm_mcnsR_s1;unit=all8;readout=cal:d_z8_pattern ~ +.4f}}.

**More model flies add nothing.** The eight wirings at all three mushroom bodies' proportions, 24 model flies, read as the eight do as they are, and so does their permuted control ({{E97/readings.csv:variant=R2_perm24;unit=all8;readout=cal:z8_pattern ~ .4f}}). A population with other brains' proportions in it gains nothing by averaging.

**A brain's proportions are a small source of spread.** On one wiring, the per-pair APL effect at the hemibrain's proportions and at a side of the male CNS's differ by {{E97/brain_term.csv:kind=brain_term:rms ~ .3f}} (root mean square over the 120 pairs), and the two sides by {{E97/brain_term.csv:kind=side_term:rms ~ .3f}}. Two draws of which claws are moved differ by {{E97/brain_term.csv:kind=move_draw_term:rms ~ .3f}}, and two of the eight wirings by {{E97/brain_term.csv:kind=wiring_draw_term:rms ~ .3f}}. Of the effect's variance over wirings and mushroom bodies, {{E97/brain_decomposition.csv:effect=per-pair APL effect:var_wiring ~ .5f}} is between wirings and {{E97/brain_decomposition.csv:effect=per-pair APL effect:var_brain ~ .5f}} between brains.

The same populations on raw spike counts, against all recordings. Two values joined by a slash are with APL on and with APL off; the response rate ρ is each wiring's own, averaged. The block is reported and carries no verdict.
